schedules.name: preview_source
schedules.barrier: Preview response bound to source hashes
schedules.mutation: Mutate one raw input byte in disposable source

schedules.name: preview_stage
schedules.barrier: Preview response bound to stage inventory

schedules.name: preview_lock
schedules.mutation: Start owned worker on another root and create actual lock/lease
schedules.expected: BUSY/stale refusal; no second worker or lock removal

schedules.name: confirm_final_preflight
schedules.barrier: Accepted confirm; actual worker paused before final preflight/first destructive operation
schedules.mutation: Change metadata or replace output ancestor at this worker barrier
schedules.expected: Reject before mutation; no earlier destructive step permitted

schedules.name: server_death_spawn
schedules.barrier: Supervisor Popen returned and exact worker birth recorded; worker paused before science
schedules.release: Restart server and submit second independent root
schedules.expected: Old worker tracked; second worker cannot start while old birth/descendants live

schedules.name: server_death_core
schedules.barrier: Worker and Core child/grandchild readiness and births recorded
schedules.release: Restart another server profile and request recovery
schedules.expected: Host-global ownership survives; no overlapping scientific workers

schedules.name: detach_during_cancel
schedules.barrier: Child recorded before setsid and blocked on release-escape; cancel accepted
schedules.mutation: Release child so it changes SID/PGID during escalation
schedules.expected: Known escaped births terminated/reaped or truthful non-CANCELLED containment state

schedules.name: force_stale_upstream
schedules.barrier: Preview routing force; executor held before full unforced-stage validation/destruction
schedules.release: Release final preflight; record validation and first deletion event order
schedules.expected: Stale discovered with zero destructive calls; any prior deletion BLOCKING

schedules.name: cancel_finish
schedules.barrier: Run twice: held before final verifier and held before result registration
schedules.mutation: Submit cancel on one side of documented terminal linearization, then reverse order
schedules.expected: Either verified COMPLETED won or accepted cancel with no registration; never false CANCELLED or forged marker

schedules.name: orphan_exit_restart
schedules.barrier: Restart sees live old worker/descendant and waits/refuses BUSY; second contender also ready
schedules.mutation: Release old fixture exit and reap all owned births
schedules.release: Release both server acquisition attempts together
schedules.expected: At most one new worker after old ownership ends; no stale-record/PID race
